20pub const NUMBER_OF_CODEWORDS: u32 = 929;
21// Maximum Codewords (Data + Error).
22pub const MAX_CODEWORDS_IN_BARCODE: u32 = NUMBER_OF_CODEWORDS - 1;
23pub const MIN_ROWS_IN_BARCODE: u32 = 3;
24pub const MAX_ROWS_IN_BARCODE: u32 = 90;
25// One left row indication column + max 30 data columns + one right row indicator column
26//public static final int MAX_CODEWORDS_IN_ROW = 32;
27pub const MODULES_IN_CODEWORD: u32 = 17;
28pub const MODULES_IN_STOP_PATTERN: u32 = 18;
29pub const BARS_IN_MODULE: u32 = 8;

31pub const EMPTY_INT_ARRAY: [u32; 0] = [];

33/**
34 * @param symbol encoded symbol to translate to a codeword
35 * @return the codeword corresponding to the symbol.
36 */
37pub fn getCodeword(symbol: u32) -> i32 {
38    SYMBOL_TABLE.binary_search(&(symbol & 0x3FFFF)).map_or_else(
39        |_| -1,
40        |pos| ((CODEWORD_TABLE[pos] - 1) % NUMBER_OF_CODEWORDS) as i32,
41    )
42    // if let Ok(pos) = SYMBOL_TABLE.binary_search(&(symbol & 0x3FFFF)) {
43    //     ((CODEWORD_TABLE[pos] - 1) % NUMBER_OF_CODEWORDS) as i32
44    // } else {
45    //     -1
46    // }
47    // int i = Arrays.binarySearch(SYMBOL_TABLE, symbol & 0x3FFFF);
48    // if (i < 0) {
49    //   return -1;
50    // }
51    // return (CODEWORD_TABLE[i] - 1) % NUMBER_OF_CODEWORDS;
52}
